title: Entry bound and uniform ellipticity of the tangential matrix S_P(L)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1, P ⊆ E a linear subspace with orthogonal projection p := P.starProjection, L : E → E a continuous linear map and b ∈ ℝ with 1 ≤ b, ‖L‖ ≤ b and ‖v‖ ≤ b‖L v‖ for every v ∈ E. For i, j ∈ Fin N put S_ij := ⟨L(p e_i), L(p e_j)⟩ + ⟨e_i − p e_i, e_j − p e_j⟩. Then (a) |S_ij| ≤ b² + 1 for all i, j ∈ Fin N, and (b) (b²)⁻¹·Σ_i ξ_i² ≤ Σ_i Σ_j ξ_i S_ij ξ_j for every ξ ∈ ℝ^{Fin N}.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (b : ℝ), 1 ≤ b → ‖L‖ ≤ b → (∀ v, ‖v‖ ≤ b * ‖L v‖) → (∀ i j : Fin N, |inner ℝ (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))| ≤ b ^ 2 + 1) ∧ ∀ ξ : Fin N → ℝ, (b ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ξ i * (inner ℝ (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)))) (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) + inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) - P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) * ξ j
